# Agent Handoff Contracts (§17)

Every transfer between agents is a validated Pydantic object, never a chat transcript.
Invariants below are enforced by model validators, so they cannot be bypassed by prompt
wording — each has a test proving it rejects bad input.

## Workflow order

```
Researcher   -> Analyst        ResearchHandoff
Analyst      -> FactChecker    AnalysisHandoff
FactChecker  -> Critic         FactCheckReport
Critic       -> Supervisor     CriticVerdict
Supervisor   -> Writer         AnalysisHandoff + CriticVerdict (already validated)
Writer       -> User           FinalReport
```

## Supervisor → all — `RequestBrief`

Structured form of the user request (§9).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `objective` | `str` | yes | The single main objective, one sentence |
| `sub_questions` | `list` | no | Specific answerable research questions the objective decomposes into |
| `evaluation_criteria` | `list` | no | Dimensions on which options should be compared |
| `deliverable` | `str` | no | What the user should receive |
| `constraints` | `list` | no |  |
| `options_under_comparison` | `list` | no | Named alternatives, when the request is a comparison. Drives the fan-out. |
| `time_horizon` | `str | None` | no |  |
| `missing_information` | `list` | no |  |
| `needs_clarification` | `bool` | no | True only when the request cannot be planned without more input |
| `clarifying_questions` | `list` | no |  |

## Supervisor → Researchers — `TaskPlan`

Dependency-ordered task plan (§11). Validated as a DAG.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tasks` | `list` | no |  |
| `rationale` | `str` | no | Why the plan is shaped this way |
| `created_by` | `AgentId` | no |  |
| `revision` | `int` | no | Bumped when the user edits or the plan re-plans |

## Researcher → Analyst — `ResearchHandoff`

One per research task; accumulates additively under the parallel fan-out.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `task_id` | `str` | yes |  |
| `research_question` | `str` | yes |  |
| `findings` | `str` | yes | Prose summary of what was found |
| `evidence_ids` | `list` | no | Ids of Evidence records this researcher stored |
| `confidence` | `Confidence` | yes |  |
| `gaps` | `list` | no |  |
| `sources_consulted` | `list` | no |  |
| `agent_id` | `AgentId` | no |  |

## Analyst → Fact-Checker / Critic — `AnalysisHandoff`

Conclusions bound to the evidence supporting them.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `summary` | `str` | yes |  |
| `conclusions` | `list` | yes |  |
| `comparison` | `list` | no |  |
| `trade_offs` | `list` | no |  |
| `assumptions` | `list` | no | Anything asserted that evidence does not establish — stated, not hidden |
| `evidence_ids_used` | `list` | no |  |
| `revision` | `int` | no | Bumped each time the Critic sends it back |
| `agent_id` | `AgentId` | no |  |

## Fact-Checker → Critic — `FactCheckReport`

Citation integrity: deterministic existence check plus model judgement.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `checks` | `list` | no |  |
| `agent_id` | `AgentId` | no |  |

## Critic → Supervisor — `CriticVerdict`

Approve/reject with actionable revisions.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `approved` | `bool` | yes |  |
| `problems` | `list` | no |  |
| `missing_evidence` | `list` | no | Questions that still need researching |
| `required_revisions` | `list` | no | Specific, actionable instructions for the Analyst |
| `scores` | `dict` | no | 1-5 per criterion |
| `needs_more_research` | `bool` | no | True routes back to research rather than re-analysis |
| `cycle` | `int` | no | Which revision cycle produced this verdict |
| `agent_id` | `AgentId` | no |  |
